summary: X -> freeze X: right in LLVM, refuted in the model
why: A frozen poison is one of the values poison allows, so LLVM accepts this. The model's tgt stops at a frozen poison instead of choosing a value, so the model refutes it at X = poison. That counterexample isn't LLVM's, and the rewrite stays uncertified rather than certified by inventing a semantics for freeze.
model_limitation: ModelStop.freezePoison: the model doesn't choose a value for a frozen poison
